title: Hair Follicle Detection System
description: A full-stack telemedicine platform built with React, FastAPI, and MongoDB. Enables remote patient-doctor interaction with automated scalp analysis using computer vision and CNN-based models following the Hamilton-Norwood scale.

title: Personal Portfolio
description: A high-performance professional hub engineered with React and Vite. Features a modular UI, JSON-driven content management, and a serverless contact system via Web3Forms for seamless communication.

title: ERP Inventory System
description: A full-stack inventory and sales management system built with React and FastAPI. Designed to handle suppliers, stock tracking, and authentication with a focus on scalable backend architecture.
